$comment: The shared blob-value conformance fixture (compat/model/README.md § Values). A blob's document form is its canonical standard base64 text in every backend: what `{"$base64": ...}` evaluates to in a check, what a blob member of a response renders as, and what an export of one puts in the context bag. `valid` pins both directions — the text decodes to exactly `hex`, and those bytes render back to exactly `base64` — and `invalid` pins what every decoder refuses rather than reads as some other bytes: another alphabet, missing padding, whitespace, and a second spelling of bytes that already have one. Every suite's unit tests read this file; a suite that cannot see it here fails when OVERCAST_COMPAT_FIXTURES_REQUIRED is set, exactly as the error fixtures do.
